title: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: Suppose the student union of your university is collecting opinions on improving its work for the coming year. You are now to write a response by suggesting how it can better enrich student life. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: I am truly glad that the student union is collecting our opinions for the coming year, and I would like to share a few thoughts on how campus life could become richer and more colourful. To begin with, I suggest that more student clubs be set up, ranging from photography to debating, so that everyone can find a hobby and make new friends. It would also be helpful if the union organized regular sports meets and art festivals, because such events relax us after study and build a stronger sense of community. Another idea is to invite experts to hold lectures and workshops, which would broaden our horizons and prepare us for future careers. I believe these suggestions, if adopted, will make our daily life on campus far more enjoyable. Thank you for listening, and I am always ready to offer any help the union may need.
keyPoints: 开门见山扣焦点。开头用『I am truly glad that the student union is collecting our opinions』回应征询，再用『share a few thoughts on how campus life could become richer』亮出 立场，一句话落实了第一段『回应征询并表态』的功能。

三条建议各带理由。三句都走『建议+理由』：『I suggest that more student clubs be set up ... so that everyone can find a hobby』『It would also be helpful if ... because such events relax us』『Another idea is to invite experts ... which would broaden our horizons』，用 To begin with / also / Another idea 分隔，落实分点给建议的功能。
回扣中心表支持。『I believe these suggestions, if adopted, will make our daily life on campus far more enjoyable』回扣丰富生活的中心，末句『I am always ready to offer any help』积 极表态收尾，无称呼落款。
